pages.text: A creep tumor shows for its first 5 seconds, then burrows: only its own side and $(l)detectors$() see it — a raven, an observer, an overseer, a turret, a cannon, a spore crawler, a detector potion. Soon after it plants one new tumor at the edge of its creep, as in SC2. It has 50 hit points: arrows and shots wound it, and units that see a foe's tumor within reach shoot it down themselves.
